subtitle: Specification-Driven Data Engineering Across 6 Human-Gated Steps on Google Cloud

root.label: Data Product Framework
root.description: Accelerates enterprise data products from candidate use case to governed outcome in 6 human-gated steps.

details.purpose: End-to-end build-time delivery framework pairing plain-English business specifications and reusable organisational context with deterministic multi-plane compilation (Dataform, dbt, Terraform, LookML, and BigQuery Knowledge Catalog) and symbiotic runtime integration with the Agentic Data Governance Framework (ADG-00).
details.sla: Offline Gates G0-G3 < 10s · Byte-Identical Deterministic Builds
details.platform_service: Python CLI, BigQuery, Dataform, Looker, Knowledge Catalog & Gemini Platform
inputs: Candidate two-page use-case forms and plain-English Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
Organisational context registries (glossary.yaml, source_systems.yaml, foundations.yaml, platform-defaults.yaml)
Concise authored SQL bodies and runtime health or AGF governance feedback events
outputs: Deterministic Dataform or dbt projects, Terraform IAM/masking modules, and governed LookML Explores & Dashboards
Signed SHA-256 plain-English semantics playbacks and digest-bound test & human attestation evidence
BigQuery Knowledge Catalog registrations carrying all 7 canonical ADG-00 Single-Writer Aspect payloads
business_rules: Plain-English Boundary (Gate G0): Business requirements contain zero database or cloud modelling jargon.
Signed Semantics Invariant (Gate G1): Any change to grain, history, or metric definitions invalidates signoff.yaml until re-signed.
Deterministic Multi-Plane Build (Gate G3): Building the same manifest twice produces byte-identical SQL, Terraform, LookML, and Catalog artefacts.
Symbiotic Governance (ADR-019): DPF enforces compile-time privacy and residency rules and emits ADG-00 aspects to Knowledge Catalog rather than duplicating runtime estate daemons.
details.delivery_unit: Composite Capability / Framework (6 chronological human-gated pillars)

implementation.summary: Runs as a zero-daemon Python CLI and Agent Skills suite in Git, compiling multi-plane Google Cloud artefacts offline and verifying live deployments in BigQuery and Knowledge Catalog.
implementation.runtime: Python 3.12 CLI, Agent Skills, Dataform/dbt, BigQuery & Looker
implementation.trigger: Developer CLI · Pull Request CI · Scheduled Business-Hours Monitor

children.label: 1. Discover & Prioritise
children.description: Evaluates candidate business ideas and ranks Value vs Ease before engineering starts.

details.purpose: Stage 1 inception pillar ensuring teams invest engineering capacity only in concrete, business-sponsored use cases with honest source feasibility visibility.
details.platform_service: DPF Define Templates & Agent Skills on Gemini Platform
inputs: Two-page candidate use-case submission (1-use-case.pdf or YAML)
outputs: Readiness assessment report, 11-criterion scorecard, and Quick Win prioritisation matrix
business_rules: Candidate submissions must state the commercial decision, measurable value, and believed sources in plain language.
Readiness review assesses completeness without pre-scoring; the human panel owns final scoring at the Portfolio Gate.

implementation.summary: Combines an agentic readiness check skill with a weighted 11-criterion scoring rubric and fillable portfolio PDF forms.
implementation.runtime: Agent Skill + Fillable PDF / YAML Scorecard

children.label: Use-Case Readiness Agent
children.description: Reviews candidate submissions against the 11-criterion evidence rubric before panel scoring.

details.purpose: Agentic inception reviewer that checks every section of a submitted 2-page use case for specificity, plain business language, and honest unknowns before the scoring panel meets.
outputs: Structured readiness verdict and pre-panel question list
business_rules: Never assigns numeric scores on behalf of the panel; flags vague value claims and hidden technical jargon.

implementation.summary: Agent skill invoked when a sponsor submits a candidate use case.

children.label: 11-Criterion Scoring Engine
children.description: Calculates weighted Value (3.05) and Ease (3.33) scores across eleven portfolio criteria.

details.purpose: Deterministic weighting rubric across Value (decision impact, strategic alignment, breadth) and Ease (source readiness, definition clarity, sponsorship).
inputs: Panel criterion scores (1-5 scale) across 11 dimensions
outputs: Weighted Value score, Ease score, total points (/170), and quadrant placement
business_rules: Weights and anchors are version-controlled in framework/templates/scoring.yaml so all domains are scored on identical terms.

implementation.summary: Declarative YAML rubric rendered into interactive fillable scorecards.

children.label: Portfolio Gate Workbench
children.description: Presents the 2x2 Quick Win vs Strategic Bet matrix for human funding sign-off.

details.purpose: Human-in-the-loop portfolio gate where leadership compares scored candidates and selects funded Quick Wins and Strategic Bets.
outputs: Approved UC-<DOMAIN>-<NNN> charter authorised for Step 2 (Describe)
business_rules: No engineering design or pipeline work starts without Portfolio Gate selection or explicit prototype fast-path status.

implementation.summary: Fillable PDF scorecard and 2x2 portfolio matrix archived alongside product specs.

children.label: 2. Describe (Gate G0)
children.description: Captures structured plain-English business requirements and validates rubric completeness.

details.purpose: Stage 2 pillar turning a funded use case into an unambiguous, jargon-free Business Requirement Document (BRD) verified deterministically at Gate G0.
details.platform_service: DPF CLI (dpf brd validate) & Agent Skills
inputs: Approved use case, registry/glossary.yaml, registry/brd-rubric.yaml, and registry/brd-vocabulary.yaml
outputs: Approved brd/spec.md + brd.yaml passing Gate G0 (or gap register of plain-English business questions)
business_rules: All 11 rubric groups (A-K) must be answered or explicitly deferred.
Modelling and cloud terms (fact table, SCD, partition, BigQuery) fail Gate G0 immediately.

implementation.summary: Pairs conversational BRD authoring and sandbox prototype import with deterministic Gate G0 rubric, glossary, and anti-jargon validation.
implementation.trigger: dpf brd validate <product> / dpf check --gate describe

children.label: Plain-English BRD Author
children.description: Interviews business stakeholders and drafts requirements strictly in commercial language.

details.purpose: Guided interview agent that translates stakeholder intent into Requirement/Scenario specs (spec.md) and structured answers (brd.yaml) without leaking technical design choices.
outputs: openspec/specs/products/<domain>/<product>/brd/spec.md & brd.yaml
business_rules: Every metric and attribute must bind to an agreed term or alias in registry/glossary.yaml.

implementation.summary: Structured interview skill enforcing the 11-group business rubric.
implementation.trigger: New Product Kickoff or Gap Register Resolution

children.label: Gate G0 Rubric Validator
children.description: Verifies groups A-K completeness, glossary alignment, and zero technical jargon.

details.purpose: Deterministic Gate G0 checker verifying brd.v1 schema conformance, spec-to-YAML version parity, scenario coverage, glossary bindings, and banned technical vocabulary.
outputs: Pass/Fail Gate G0 report and plain-English gaps.md question list
business_rules: Deferred requirements (**Status:** deferred) remain documented in spec.md without blocking v1 delivery.

implementation.summary: Deterministic Python validator invoked via CLI and CI.
implementation.trigger: dpf brd validate / dpf check --gate describe

children.label: Business Need Sign-Off
children.description: Captures named business owner approval on the jargon-free requirement specification.

details.purpose: Human Business Need Gate ensuring the domain sponsor confirms the commercial rules, timeliness, privacy boundaries, and exceptions before technical design begins.
outputs: Approved BRD version (e.g. BRD-SALES-002@1.2.0)
business_rules: Gate G0 stays red until approval.approved_by and approval.role are recorded by the business owner.

implementation.summary: Readable 4-page Markdown or PDF business specification signed by the business owner.

children.label: Prototype Sandbox Importer
children.description: Imports existing Dataform or LookML repositories into fast-path prototype mode.

details.purpose: Reverse-onboarding adapter that ingests brownfield Dataform SQLX or Looker LookML projects (including shadow assets flagged by AGF ADG-05) into status: prototype manifests.
inputs: Existing Dataform repository or LookML project directory
outputs: Scaffolded products/<id>/product.yaml in prototype mode ready for dpf proto promote
business_rules: Prototype products pass structural --gate proto checks immediately but cannot pass G1 until promoted with a signed BRD and TDD.

implementation.summary: CLI importers parsing SQLX config blocks and LookML views/explores/dashboards.
implementation.trigger: dpf proto import-dataform / dpf proto import-looker

children.label: 3. Design (Gate G1)
children.description: Resolves grain, history, methodology, Looker safety, and AGF privacy rules with playback sign-off.

details.purpose: Stage 3 pillar translating the approved BRD into a justified technical design (TDD + product.yaml), verifying source feasibility and AGF C6/C10 rules, and binding business sign-off to a SHA-256 semantic digest.
details.platform_service: DPF Design Engine (dpf/design.py), Methodology Packs & Goldfish Verifier
outputs: Validated tdd/spec.md, product.yaml, plain-English semantics.md, and signed signoff.yaml
business_rules: Every requirement must be realised by a design element, and every design element must cite a requirement or platform capability (zero orphans).
Departures from default direct methodology or Looker no-PDT rules require an Architecture Decision Record (ADR).

implementation.summary: Combines methodology recommendation, deterministic Gate G1 + AGF C6/C10 checks, zero-context blind playback verification, and SHA-256 semantic digest signing.
implementation.trigger: dpf tdd resolve / dpf check --gate G1 / dpf signoff

children.label: TDD & Methodology Resolver
children.description: Recommends direct vs Kimball modelling and surfaces source connectivity constraints early.

details.purpose: Technical design resolver that evaluates BRD history and shared-dimension signals, checks source capture modes in registry/source_systems.yaml, and drafts tdd/spec.md, semantics.md, and product.yaml.
outputs: tdd/spec.md, tdd/semantics.md, and products/<id>/product.yaml
business_rules: Unachievable source SLAs (such as inbound CDC on an outbound-only database) must be raised back to the business rather than silently downgraded.

implementation.summary: Guided TDD resolution skill backed by deterministic methodology recommendation.
implementation.runtime: Gemini Platform / Coding Agent Skill + Python CLI

children.label: Gate G1 & AGF Privacy Engine
children.description: Enforces grain parity, SCD2 surrogate joins, Looker rules, and AGF C6/C10 privacy gates.

details.purpose: Deterministic design gate checking 100% requirement realisation, Kimball/direct pack rules, zero silent staging WHERE drops, Stephen Few zero-baseline charts, policy-tag coverage on AGF RESTRICTED columns, and zero RESTRICTED leaks on external BigQuery sharing ports.
inputs: product.yaml, authored SQL bodies, tdd/spec.md, and registry overlays
outputs: Deterministic Gate G1 pass/fail verdict
business_rules: Any AGF C6 RESTRICTED column lacking a policy tag or exposed on a sharing_listing port fails Gate G1 immediately.

implementation.summary: Core static verifier across SQL ASTs, schemas, LookML, and AGF governance bindings.

children.label: Zero-Context Playback Critic
children.description: Audits product.yaml and SQL blind against semantics.md to catch conversational anchoring.

details.purpose: Isolated zero-context subagent pass that reads only product.yaml and SQL bodies—never the BRD or authoring chat—to independently derive behaviour and diff it against semantics.md.
outputs: Semantic drift critique before business sign-off
business_rules: Runs in a fresh subagent context with zero memory of authoring compromises.

implementation.summary: Zero-context subagent verification skill invoked prior to dpf signoff.

children.label: Playback Sign-Off Ledger
children.description: Persists SHA-256 semantic digest signatures in signoff.yaml to lock business meaning.

details.purpose: Single-ledger persistence module recording the business owner's cryptographic signature over grain, history, filters, measures, and scenarios.
inputs: Approver identity, role, and scenario list
outputs: openspec/specs/products/<domain>/<product>/tdd/signoff.yaml
business_rules: Editing semantics.md, grain_columns, history_semantics, or LookML metric filters changes semantic_digest and automatically invalidates signoff.yaml.

implementation.summary: CLI command writing schema-validated signoff.yaml bound to the current BRD version and semantic hash.

crud_entities.notes: Primary owned ledger binding business approval to SHA-256 semantic_digest
Read-only input used to compute canonical semantic_digest

children.label: Business Playback Gate
children.description: Presents one-page plain-English semantics.md for business owner confirmation.

details.purpose: Human Playback Sign-Off Gate where the business owner reads a jargon-free summary of inclusions, exclusions, history rules, privacy masking, and known source limitations.
outputs: Authorised business sign-off unlocking Step 4 (Build)
business_rules: Business owners never review SQL or YAML; they sign plain-English behaviour backed by a machine-checked digest.

implementation.summary: One-page business playback document reviewed and signed before pipeline generation.

children.label: 4. Build (Gates G2-G3)
children.description: Composes stage skills and compiles deterministic SQL, Terraform, Catalog, and LookML.

details.purpose: Stage 4 pillar composing the typed skill DAG (Gate G2) and deterministically compiling one product manifest into synchronised Dataform/dbt, Terraform, Knowledge Catalog, and Looker artefacts (Gate G3).
inputs: Signed product.yaml, authored SQL bodies, engine adapters, and methodology templates
outputs: Byte-identical generated/<product>/ bundle verified against tests/golden/<product>/
business_rules: Every generated artefact is stamped in MANIFEST.json with a SHA-256 build_digest.
Two consecutive in-memory builds must be 100% byte-identical (zero nondeterministic timestamps or unordered sets).

implementation.summary: Offline deterministic compiler emitting Dataform/dbt SQL, Terraform HCL, LookML views/dashboards, GEMINI.md agent guardrails, and 7 ADG-00 Knowledge Catalog aspects.
implementation.trigger: dpf compose / dpf generate / Pull Request CI

children.label: Gate G2 Pipeline Composer
children.description: Selects stage skills and type-checks contract handoffs and engine support across the DAG.

details.purpose: Deterministic DAG composer matching source capture modes, layer roles, quality gates, and output ports to registered skills and verifying every input/output JSON Schema handoff.
outputs: dag.json, dag.md, and verified AX-to-AT acceptance coverage
business_rules: Fails immediately if a model requests a role or streaming/batch engine combination not implemented by an adapter.

implementation.summary: Static skill selector and contract type-checker.

children.label: Bounded Dataform SQL Agent
children.description: Assists messy source SQL wrangling inside deterministic GEMINI.md guardrails.

details.purpose: Tier-3 leaf worker integration (ADR-017) allowing Google Cloud's native Dataform Data Engineering Agent to assist with source SQL cleansing while keeping grain, quarantine, and release schedules locked by DPF.
details.platform_service: BigQuery Dataform Agent on Gemini Platform (ADR-017)
inputs: Generated dataform/GEMINI.md guardrails and raw source schemas
outputs: Authored staging/gold SQL bodies compliant with engine-neutral ref/var rules
business_rules: Governed Dataform builds disable unreviewed console auto-releases so all changes pass Gate G1 and Gate G3.

implementation.summary: Emits deterministic dataform/GEMINI.md context and disables unmanaged hourly releases.

agent_config.hitl_mode: Bounded by GEMINI.md + Golden Copy PR

children.label: Gate G3 Multi-Plane Compiler
children.description: Compiles Dataform/dbt SQL, Terraform IAM, LookML, and 7 ADG-00 Catalog aspects.

details.purpose: Single-manifest deterministic compiler rendering SQLX/SQL models, SCD2 history & point-in-time joins, Terraform datasets/policy tags/BigQuery sharing/quality scans, LookML Explores & Stephen Few dashboards, and catalog-registration.json.
details.platform_service: DPF Generators (dataform.py, dbt.py, terraform.py, lookml.py, docs.py)
inputs: Composed RenderPlan, ProductGraph, and signed product.yaml
outputs: 50-110 deterministic files stamped in MANIFEST.json
business_rules: Validates every emitted JSON contract against Draft 2020-12 JSON Schemas and checks full R -> D -> Artefact -> Test traceability.

implementation.summary: Pure-Python deterministic multi-plane code generator.
implementation.runtime: Python CLI + CI Toolchain Validation (Terraform, Dataform, dbt)

children.label: Watermark Control Ledger
children.description: Maintains atomic high-watermark and batch manifest rows in dpf_watermark_log.

details.purpose: Single-table operational control ledger provisioned by Terraform to track high-watermarks, lookback windows, row counts, and load status per source entity.
outputs: Atomic watermark checkpoint row advancing the next incremental extract window
business_rules: Raw rows and the watermark control row commit together so failed loads never advance the watermark.

implementation.summary: Provisioned via generated Terraform control table resource and written atomically by the watermark extractor.

crud_entities.notes: Primary owned control table storing per-entity high-watermark checkpoints

children.label: Golden Copy PR Review
children.description: Surfaces byte-identical SQL, Terraform, and LookML diffs for engineer PR approval.

details.purpose: Human engineering gate in Git where reviewers inspect exact diffs across SQL, IAM masking, LookML, and Knowledge Catalog contracts before merge and release.
details.platform_service: GitHub Pull Request + CI Golden Copy Check
inputs: Committed tests/golden/<product>/ snapshot vs fresh dpf generate build
outputs: Approved merge to main triggering controlled deployment
business_rules: CI blocks any pull request whose generated output drifts from tests/golden/ or fails real-tool compilation.

implementation.summary: Standard Git diff review over committed golden snapshots backed by GitHub Actions.
implementation.runtime: GitHub Pull Request UI & Actions CI

children.label: 5. Accept (Gate G4)
children.description: Runs live BigQuery assertions, captures human attestations, and publishes Catalog ports.

details.purpose: Stage 5 pillar proving the deployed build on real cloud data: landing incremental extracts, quarantining bad rows, running digest-bound BigQuery SQL acceptance tests, recording Finance/domain human attestations, and registering published ports in BigQuery Knowledge Catalog.
details.sla: 100% Blocking Test & Attestation Pass Required Before Publish
details.platform_service: BigQuery, Dataform/dbt, Knowledge Catalog MCP & DPF Test Runner
inputs: Deployed BigQuery datasets/models, test-spec.json, and domain reviewer checks
outputs: Digest-bound test-evidence.v1 records and published Knowledge Catalog Data Product
business_rules: Evidence recorded against an older build_digest is rejected as stale at Gate G4.
Non-SQL business truths (such as general ledger reconciliation) require explicit human attestation before publication.

implementation.summary: Combines outbound extraction, staging reject quarantine, live BigQuery acceptance SQL execution, human CLI attestation, and Knowledge Catalog MCP registration.
implementation.runtime: BigQuery + Python CLI + Knowledge Catalog MCP
implementation.trigger: dpf test run --live / dpf test attest / dpf check --gate accept

children.label: Outbound Watermark Extractor
children.description: Extracts incremental source rows with lookback safety into append-only raw BigQuery.

details.purpose: Tier-5 outbound source connector (ADR-015) for on-premises databases without inbound cloud routes, reading watermark windows with a configurable lookback overlap into raw BigQuery tables.
details.platform_service: Cloud Run Jobs / On-Premises Runner -> BigQuery Storage Write / Load
outputs: Append-only raw_<entity> BigQuery rows + landing-manifest.v1
business_rules: Applies lookback_minutes behind the last watermark to capture late-committing transactions safely.

implementation.summary: Outbound Python extractor carrying mandatory ADR-015 bespoke-code governance markers.
implementation.runtime: Python Batch Job / Cloud Run Job

children.label: Quarantine Reject Ledger
children.description: Routes invalid staging rows to _rejects relations and blocks partial publication.

details.purpose: Single-relation staging quarantine gate separating unusable source rows with explicit rule failure reasons while halting downstream refreshes when gate_behaviour is block.
inputs: Deduplicated staging candidate rows and quality.rules (on_fail: quarantine)
outputs: <model>_rejects relation with failed rule IDs and blocking assertion status
business_rules: Top-level WHERE filters in staging SQL are blocked at G1 so bad rows are quarantined visibly rather than silently dropped.

implementation.summary: Compiled automatically into Dataform SQLX or dbt staging wrappers and reject assertions.

crud_entities.notes: Primary owned quarantine relation holding rejected source rows and failure rule IDs

children.label: Live Acceptance Test Runner
children.description: Executes automated BigQuery SQL assertions and static checks bound to build_digest.

details.purpose: Gate G4 test runner executing grain uniqueness, SCD2 non-overlap, foreign-key integrity, LookML explore dry-runs, and business scenario SQL queries against the deployed sandbox or prod project.
inputs: Generated test-spec.json and live BigQuery datasets
outputs: Timestamped run-<UTC>.json evidence bound to artefact_digest
business_rules: Any mismatch between the deployed build_digest and recorded evidence fails Gate G4 automatically.

implementation.summary: Executes SQL and static checks from test-spec.json and records schema-valid evidence.

children.label: Domain Attestation Gate
children.description: Records Finance and domain expert sign-offs on non-SQL business truths at Gate G4.

details.purpose: Human Outcome Attestation Gate capturing accountable domain verification (such as general ledger reconciliation or merchandising hierarchy sign-off) that SQL assertions alone cannot prove.
inputs: Sandbox acceptance outputs, AGF C12 GL reconciliation reports, and Looker views
outputs: Signed attestation evidence record unlocking publication
business_rules: Products remain provisional until every attestation case in acceptance.yaml passes for the current build_digest.

implementation.summary: Records named human attestations and optional reconciliation links against the active build digest.

children.label: Knowledge Catalog Publisher
children.description: Registers published ports, glossary EntryLinks, and 7 ADG-00 aspects in Catalog.

details.purpose: Tier-1 MCP publication worker registering authoritative output ports, attaching Business Glossary terms, and writing all 7 canonical ADG-00 Single-Writer Aspects to BigQuery Knowledge Catalog.
details.platform_service: BigQuery Knowledge Catalog MCP Server & BigQuery Sharing
inputs: catalog-registration.json, data-product.json, and green Gate G4 evidence
outputs: Published Knowledge Catalog Data Product and Metadata Change Feed events for AGF
business_rules: Refuses to flip status to published without signed semantics and complete Gate G4 evidence.

implementation.summary: Tier-1 MCP skill publishing catalog entries, aspects, and glossary links.

children.label: 6. Monitor (Day 2 Loop)
children.description: Evaluates business-calendar SLOs and AGF estate alerts to open traced change proposals.

details.purpose: Stage 6 Day-2 operational pillar watching freshness, volume, quality scans, and AGF runtime drift strictly inside working-hour calendars and routing breaches into requirement-traced Change Proposals.
details.sla: 15m Business-Hours Freshness Watch · Zero Weekend False Alarms
details.platform_service: DPF Monitor (dpf/monitor.py), Cloud Monitoring & AGF Estate Feedback
outputs: Targeted operational alerts and pre-populated openspec/changes/ delta proposals
business_rules: Freshness SLOs evaluate only inside the consuming team's business calendar (e.g. Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00 Australia/Perth).
Every runtime breach maps directly back to the exact BRD requirement ID placed at risk.

implementation.summary: Evaluates runtime evidence against business-calendar SLOs and auto-scaffolds OpenSpec change proposals naming the breached requirement.
implementation.runtime: Scheduled CLI / Cloud Run Check + Git Change Loop
implementation.trigger: Scheduled 15m Watch or AGF Metadata Change Feed Alert

children.label: Business-Calendar Monitor
children.description: Evaluates freshness, volume, and schema drift strictly during business working hours.

details.purpose: Deterministic SLO evaluator comparing table build timestamps, row-volume bands, and schema drift events against the product's business calendar and runbook.
outputs: Requirement-traced SLO pass/breach verdict and runbook pointer
business_rules: Suppresses staleness noise outside declared working days/hours while immediately flagging breaking schema drift.

implementation.summary: Calendar-aware Python SLO evaluator.

children.label: AGF & Catalog Breach Feed
children.description: Ingests AGF lineage, ledger, and Knowledge Catalog scan alerts as run-evidence.v1.

details.purpose: Symbiotic feedback connector (ADR-019) translating AGF ADG-02 OpenLineage drift, ADG-03 GL reconciliation variances, and Knowledge Catalog Auto-DQ failures into DPF run-evidence.v1 records.
details.platform_service: BigQuery Knowledge Catalog Scans & AGF Telemetry -> DPF
inputs: Knowledge Catalog DataScan results and AGF ADG-02/03/05 alerts
outputs: Standardised run-evidence.v1 JSON events
business_rules: Keeps DPF decoupled from runtime daemons via the versioned run-evidence.v1 schema.

implementation.summary: Typed JSON contract bridging Knowledge Catalog and AGF runtime guardians back to DPF.
implementation.trigger: Runtime Drift, Quality Scan, or GL Variance Event

children.label: Build & Run Evidence Ledger
children.description: Stores immutable test, attestation, and runtime health evidence per build digest.

details.purpose: Single-ledger audit trail storing timestamped test-evidence.v1 and run-evidence.v1 records keyed by product_id and SHA-256 build_digest.
inputs: Automated test runs, human attestations, and runtime monitor snapshots
outputs: Auditable evidence/<product>/run-*.json & attest-*.json files
business_rules: Append-only evidence files never overwrite prior runs; Gate G4 evaluates the latest result matching the active build_digest.

implementation.summary: Append-only JSON evidence ledger validated against test-evidence.v1.
implementation.trigger: dpf test run / dpf test attest

crud_entities.notes: Primary owned audit ledger of digest-bound test and attestation records

children.label: Change Proposal Workbench
children.description: Opens requirement-traced delta specs for human review when breaches or new needs arise.

details.purpose: Human Change Proposal Gate closing the Day-2 loop: drafts pre-populated ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED delta specs under openspec/changes/ naming the affected BRD requirement.
inputs: Detected runtime SLO/AGF breach or new stakeholder metric request
outputs: openspec/changes/<change-id>/ proposal ready to re-run Gates G0-G4
business_rules: Every Day-2 change flows through the exact same human-gated digest and golden-copy checks in hours rather than ad-hoc hotfixes.

implementation.summary: Scaffolds structured change proposals linking operational alerts straight back to business requirements.
